items.message:
@replay : ∀ {σ : Type u_2} (f d e : σ →₀ ℕ),
  hasseCoeff d (f + d) * hasseCoeff e (f + d + e) = hasseCoeff d (d + e) * hasseCoeff (d + e) (f + (d + e))

          (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j x ↦ LE.le.trans (MvPolynomial.monomial_le_degreeOf j hk) (hP j))))

theorem Roth.eval_diag.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (x : ℝ),
  eval x (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (Roth.diag P)) =
    (MvPolynomial.eval fun x_1 ↦ x) ((MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P) :=
fun {σ} P x ↦
  MvPolynomial.induction_on P
    (fun a ↦
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congr
            (congrArg Eq
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (eval x)
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))
                      (Eq.trans (congrArg (⇑(MvPolynomial.aeval fun x ↦ X)) (eq_intCast MvPolynomial.C a))
                        (map_intCast (MvPolynomial.aeval fun x ↦ X) a)))
                    (Polynomial.map_intCast (Int.castRingHom ℝ) a)))
                eval_intCast))
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (⇑(MvPolynomial.eval fun x_1 ↦ x))
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (⇑(MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))) (eq_intCast MvPolynomial.C a))
                  (map_intCast (MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) a)))
              (map_intCast (MvPolynomial.eval fun x_1 ↦ x) a)))
          (eq_self ↑a)))
    (fun p q a a_1 ↦
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congr
            (congrArg Eq
              (Eq.trans
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg (eval x)
                    (Eq.trans (congrArg (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) (map_add (MvPolynomial.aeval fun x ↦ X) p q))
                      (Polynomial.map_add (Int.castRingHom ℝ))))
                  eval_add)
                (congr
                  (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                    (id
                      (Eq.mp
                        (congrArg (Eq (eval x (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun x ↦ X) p))))
                          (MvPolynomial.eval_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (fun x_1 ↦ x) p))
                        a)))
                  (id
                    (Eq.mp
                      (congrArg (Eq (eval x (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun x ↦ X) q))))
                        (MvPolynomial.eval_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (fun x_1 ↦ x) q))
                      a_1)))))
            (Eq.trans
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (⇑(MvPolynomial.eval fun x_1 ↦ x)) (map_add (MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) p q))
                (map_add (MvPolynomial.eval fun x_1 ↦ x) ((MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) p)
                  ((MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) q)))
              (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (MvPolynomial.eval_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (fun x_1 ↦ x) p))
                (MvPolynomial.eval_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (fun x_1 ↦ x) q))))
          (eq_self
            (MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (fun x_1 ↦ x) p +
              MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (fun x_1 ↦ x) q))))
    fun p n a ↦
    of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congr
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (eval x)
                  (Eq.trans
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrArg (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))
                        (Eq.trans (map_mul (MvPolynomial.aeval fun x ↦ X) p (MvPolynomial.X n))
                          (congrArg (HMul.hMul ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun x ↦ X) p))
                            (MvPolynomial.aeval_X (fun x ↦ X) n))))
                      (Polynomial.map_mul (Int.castRingHom ℝ)))
                    (congrArg (HMul.hMul (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun x ↦ X) p)))
                      (map_X (Int.castRingHom ℝ)))))
                eval_mul)
              (congr
                (congrArg HMul.hMul
                  (id
                    (Eq.mp
                      (congrArg (Eq (eval x (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun x ↦ X) p))))
                        (MvPolynomial.eval_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (fun x_1 ↦ x) p))
                      a)))
                eval_X)))
          (Eq.trans
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (⇑(MvPolynomial.eval fun x_1 ↦ x))
                (Eq.trans (map_mul (MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) p (MvPolynomial.X n))
                  (congrArg (HMul.hMul ((MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) p))
                    (MvPolynomial.map_X (Int.castRingHom ℝ) n))))
              (map_mul (MvPolynomial.eval fun x_1 ↦ x) ((MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) p) (MvPolynomial.X n)))
            (congr (congrArg HMul.hMul (MvPolynomial.eval_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (fun x_1 ↦ x) p))
              (MvPolynomial.eval_X n))))
        (eq_self (MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (fun x_1 ↦ x) p * x)))

theorem Roth.diag_sub.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (P Q : MvPolynomial σ ℤ),
  Roth.diag (P - Q) = Roth.diag P - Roth.diag Q :=
fun {σ} P Q ↦ map_sub (MvPolynomial.aeval fun x ↦ X) P Q
@Roth.geom_sum_le_one_add_pow : ∀ {t : ℝ}, 0 ≤ t → ∀ (r : ℕ), ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), t ^ s ≤ (1 + t) ^ r

theorem Roth.geom_sum_le_one_add_pow : ∀ {t : ℝ}, 0 ≤ t → ∀ (r : ℕ), ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), t ^ s ≤ (1 + t) ^ r :=
fun {t} ht r ↦
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), t ^ s ≤ _a ^ r) (add_comm 1 t)))
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), t ^ s ≤ _a) (add_pow t 1 r)))
      (Finset.sum_le_sum fun m hm ↦
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ t ^ m ≤ t ^ m * _a * ↑(r.choose m)) (one_pow (r - m))))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ t ^ m ≤ _a * ↑(r.choose m)) (mul_one (t ^ m))))
            (le_mul_of_one_le_right (pow_nonneg ht m)
              (cast
                (Eq.symm
                  (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (Eq.symm Nat.cast_one)) ↑(r.choose m)) Nat.cast_le._simp_1))
                (Nat.choose_pos (Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mp hm)))))))

@Roth.abs_eval_le : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) {r : σ → ℕ},
  (∀ (j : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf j P ≤ r j) →
    ∀ {B : ℝ},
      (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), |↑(P.coeff d)| ≤ B) →
        ∀ (x : σ → ℝ), |(MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P)| ≤ B * ∏ j, (1 + |x j|) ^ r j

theorem Roth.abs_eval_le.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) {r : σ → ℕ},
  (∀ (j : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf j P ≤ r j) →
    ∀ {B : ℝ},
      (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), |↑(P.coeff d)| ≤ B) →
        ∀ (x : σ → ℝ),
          |(MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P)| ≤ B * ∏ j, (1 + |x j|) ^ r j :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] P {r} hP {B} hB x ↦
  have hB0 := LE.le.trans (abs_nonneg ↑(P.coeff 0)) (hB 0);
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ |_a| ≤ B * ∏ j, (1 + |x j|) ^ r j) (MvPolynomial.eval_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) x P)))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ |_a| ≤ B * ∏ j, (1 + |x j|) ^ r j) (MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq' (Int.castRingHom ℝ) x P)))
      (Trans.trans
        (Trans.trans
          (LE.le.trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs (fun k ↦ ↑(P.coeff k) * ∏ j, x j ^ k j) P.support)
            (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k x_1 ↦
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrFun'
                    (congrArg LE.le
                      (Eq.trans (abs_mul (↑(P.coeff k)) (∏ j, x j ^ k j))
                        (congrArg (HMul.hMul |↑(P.coeff k)|)
                          (Eq.trans (Finset.abs_prod Finset.univ fun x_2 ↦ x x_2 ^ k x_2)
                            (Finset.prod_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x_2 a ↦ abs_pow (x x_2) (k x_2))))))
                    (B * ∏ j, |x j| ^ k j)))
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB k)
                  (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i x_2 ↦ pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg (x i)) (k i)))))
          (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
            (fun k hk ↦ Roth.mem_box.mpr fun j ↦ LE.le.trans (MvPolynomial.monomial_le_degreeOf j hk) (hP j))
            fun x_1 x_2 x_3 ↦ mul_nonneg hB0 (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i x_4 ↦ pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg (x i)) (x_1 i))))
        (Roth.sum_box_prod_pow_le_aux✝ r hB0 x)))
